title: bye
description: server → host and clients. Last message before the server closes the socket. Carries the reason because browsers do not reliably expose close reasons. The WebSocket close code equals closeCode.

reason.description: Why the connection is being closed.

closeCode.description: WebSocket close code the server uses (fixed per reason, see ByeReason).

canResume.description: True when the token is still valid and the client should reconnect and send `room.resume` (SERVER_SHUTDOWN, IDLE_TIMEOUT, FLOOD, PROTOCOL_VIOLATION). False otherwise.

ByeReason.description: Reason the server is about to close the connection. Each value has a fixed WebSocket close code.
